# Vestaboard

Vestaboard is a smart messaging display that allows users to send and receive messages through a mechanical split-flap display.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/vestaboard/.

## Actions

- **List Subscriptions** (read-only): List all subscriptions accessible to the authenticated user.
- **Send Message to Subscription**: Send a message to a specific vestaboard subscription.
